name: UptimeRobot
desc: Monitor your websites, APIs, and servers. Get alerted when things go down.

actions.name: get_monitors
actions.description: List and search your UptimeRobot monitors with optional filters. Leave the Monitors / Monitor IDs fields empty to return all monitors.

actions.name: create_monitor
actions.description: Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in UptimeRobot

actions.name: edit_monitor
actions.description: Update the settings of an existing UptimeRobot monitor

actions.name: delete_monitor
actions.description: Permanently delete a monitor from UptimeRobot. This cannot be undone.

actions.name: pause_resume_monitor
actions.description: Temporarily pause or resume monitoring for a specific monitor.
